'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the drawers, the chatbox message "The drawers are locked!  One of the wizards might have the key..." is displayed, hinting that you must kill a [[wizard]] to get the key.
